connector.name: Cookie Consent Compliance Scanner
connector.registryDescription: Cookie consent scanner: GDPR, CCPA, GCMv2. PASS/FAIL compliance checklists with fix recommendations.
connector.summary: Hosted at consent-analyser-emea.waivern.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vincentn-waivern account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional bearer token for private scans. Format: 'Bearer wvn_xxx'. Generate at https://consent-analyser-emea.waivern.com/account/tokens. If omitted, scans are anonymous and public.
